title: Grateful Dead Live at Cameron Indoor Stadium, Duke U on 1982-04-02
lineage: Master Soundboard Cassette > Cassette > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy Duke show, highlighted by a smoking Sugaree and a monster China Cat Sunflower→I Know You Rider transition.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard source that sounds good overall, though listeners should mind the channel swaps after Jerry and Phil switched sides. The concert itself is remembered as a hot, high‑energy performance with standout moments like Sugaree, China/Know You Rider and strong Jerry leads, despite a few first‑song wobble and minor flubs.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is ~4.1/5; most comments praise both the music and recording, with only occasional minor complaints.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall sound but channel placement changes after the Jerry‑Phil side swap; first song a bit wavy, some listeners note need for headphones to verify proper left/right balance.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set with solid song choices, a high‑energy second set that builds into a monster transition; overall pacing kept the crowd fired up.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Lots of sweet Jerry tunes noted (Candyman, Sugaree); stage right placement mentioned, generally praised for tone and leads.
band_member_comments.Phil: Steady, sub‑sonic bass playing; highlighted for the side‑switching that affected channel balance.
band_member_comments.Bob: Good rhythm guitar work noted as "Bobby was good".
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's position (right) mentioned for channel reference; no specific performance comments.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey seen at the window, no direct commentary on drumming quality.
